seo.description: Pipe Volume Calculator — Calculate pipe internal volume and liquid capacity for filling, flushing, and hydrotesting with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.explanation: V = π(D/2)² × L. Diameter in m, length in m; ×1000 converts m³ to liters.

content.introduction: Calculate the total internal volume of a pipe section. Essential for hydrotesting (water required), chemical treatment dosing, and fluid inventory management.

faq.a: Calculate pipe volume and add 10-20% for filling losses and venting. Also calculate for the test pump capacity needs.
Use inner diameter (ID), not outer diameter (OD). Schedule 40 4-inch pipe has ~102mm ID vs 114.3mm OD.

faq.q: How do I convert pipe volume between liters and gallons?
faq.a: 1 m³ = 1000 L = 264.17 US gallons = 219.97 imperial gallons. For a 100 mm ID pipe, 1 m of length holds about 7.85 L. Multiply volume in m³ by 1000 to get liters.

sections.heading: Unit Conversion for Pipe Volume
sections.body:
**Volume units**

- 1 m³ = 1000 L = 264.17 US gal = 219.97 imp gal
- 1 US gal = 3.785 L
- 1 L = 0.001 m³

**Length units**

- 1 m = 3.28084 ft
- 1 inch = 25.4 mm

**Diameter units**

- 1 inch = 25.4 mm

Pipe volume V = π/4 × D² × L requires consistent units. For hydrotest fill volumes, convert the result to liters or gallons as needed.
